query: are all properties in noida leasehold
answer:
Yes, virtually all residential and commercial land across Noida, Greater Noida, and the Yamuna Expressway is leasehold—typically allotted for 90 to 99 years by the local development authority. 

The authority retains ultimate ownership of the underlying land. When you purchase a property here, you own the superstructure and hold a registered tripartite sub-lease deed. Blanket freehold conversion remains deferred under Uttar Pradesh state policy. 

Because of this structure, buying resale requires verifying that the builder has cleared all multi-crore land dues with the authority, alongside obtaining a Transfer Memorandum (TM) before your sub-lease deed can be registered. A standard Society/RWA clearance for maintenance is not enough.
